scope: Seven retained documents, fresh UI authoring, one native Review/Revision, independent read-only calculations. Not a full eight-document authoring test or a game/runtime test.

usage.note: Observed provider token usage, not account Credit settlement. Initial failed provider request has unknown usage.

passed: Seven retained documents stayed byte-identical during UI authoring (upstream-preservation.json). Review then revised UI, Scene, Technical, Art and Asset Plan; GDD, Balance and Audio remained unchanged.

Native authoring used the supplied layout calculator, observed errors, repaired the menu compact layout and recomputed. Native Review detected and revised the original prompt/paddle placement conflict.

Independent calculations of menu and game/HUD/modal compositions at eight host sizes found no viewport, parent or padded-content overflow and no active foreground sibling rectangle intersections (geometry.json).
Menu compact transition at widths 600 and 601 passed at each sampled height (geometry.json boundaryChecks).
Four retained prompt projection samples match the actual camera-derived world rectangle within 0.001 screen pixels; the gap to paddle top is 28 world pixels (prompt-projections.json).

findings.summary: The revised prompt is absent from the reusable full-host game draft. Review instead produced four fixed-host probe drafts containing manually copied frame and projected prompt rectangles.
findings.impact: The four sample projections are numerically correct, but the claim that game-view, HUD, prompt and overlays were calculated together against the final authored relationships is not established. The prose world-coordinate formula has not become one reusable complete calculation input. This is an evidence/input gap, not proof that the intended projection formula is wrong.

findings.summary: S6 loading-error UI is planned but has no corresponding draft or calculated reference/minimum composition.
findings.impact: The independent geometry pass covers the supplied menu, game/HUD/modals and four prompt samples, not all planned player-visible screens.

findings.summary: Art Direction reserves letterbox margins for HUD/serve-prompt text without animation, while UI specifies serve-prompt inside the projected world rectangle and with breathing animation.
findings.impact: The documents still disagree on prompt placement and animation despite the native claim that the cross-document conflict was closed.

unverified: Actual font measurement, shaping, wrapping, clipping and appearance.

Gameplay occlusion, interactions, focus, touch target behavior and real-device readability. In particular, the pause visual rectangle is 72x32 while prose requires a 44x44 hit box; no separate hit-region geometry was calculated.
Resource production, resource binding, game implementation and runtime acceptance.
All possible viewport sizes; declared boundary probes and finite samples are diagnostic evidence only.
conclusion: The calculator and these sampled layouts work. The complete UI authoring/review calculation loop is still incomplete; do not promote native completion to full independent design acceptance. Stop here rather than silently adding paid repair turns or modifying the Agent's evidence.
